fact: 在劳合·乔治推动下，英国确立了面向70岁及以上老人的非缴费养老金制度，标准为每周5先令。

sources.title: Abraham Epstein, Facing old age: a study of old age dependency in the United States and old age pensions (Gutenberg eBook #77562)
sources.quote: Due to the influence of Lloyd George, a straight old-age pension system was adopted by Great Britain ... Pensions, under this law, are granted to all men and women, married or single, who have attained their 70th year. ... the hope of five shillings per week in the dim and uncertain future

fact: 1909年6月，弗雷德里克·汉德利·佩奇把他的工棚改建为汉德利·佩奇有限公司（Handley Page, Ltd.），这是英国第一家公开交易的飞机制造公司。

sources.title: Handley-Page (U.S. Centennial of Flight)
sources.quote: In June 1909, he turned his shed into the firm of Handley Page, Ltd. This was Great Britain's first publicly traded aircraft manufacturing corporation.

fact: 汉德利·佩奇公司在一战中为英国海军研制双发0/100轰炸机，该机于1915年末首飞，使公司走上快速发展道路，其后又发展出0/400和V/1500两种更大的后继型号。

sources.title: Handley-Page (U.S. Centennial of Flight)
sources.quote: This led to the development of the twin-engine 0/100 bomber, which first flew late in 1915. The 0/100 started the company on its way. Built as a biplane, it led to two larger successors: the 0/400 and the V/1500.

fact: 1909年2月，阿尔伯特·肖特（Albert Short）获得威尔伯·赖特的许可，在英国制造赖特飞机。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Timeline: 1909
sources.quote: Feb-09 Albert Short obtains a license from Wilbur Wright to manufacture Wright planes in Britain

fact: 汉德利·佩奇公司因开缝翼（slotted wing）专利自其他飞机制造商处收取权利金，1919年10月24日获授专利后，专利权销售为其带来75万（约合当时360万美元）的收入，专利授权成为该公司的关键财源之一。

sources.title: Handley-Page (U.S. Centennial of Flight)
sources.quote: Handley-Page received a patent for the invention on October 24, 1919, and slotted wings became a key to the firm's fortunes, as sales of patent rights earned 750,000 (about $3.6 million at the time) in payments from other planebuilders.

fact: 战后汉德利·佩奇把0/400改装为客机，其新设的汉德利·佩奇运输公司（Handley Page Transport）1919年开业，成为世界最早的航空公司之一；1924年该公司与其他三家航空公司合并组建帝国航空公司（Imperial Airways），即英国第一家国家航空公司。

sources.title: Handley-Page (U.S. Centennial of Flight)
sources.quote: Several of them became airliners with minimal modification, while the new firm of Handley Page Transport, which opened in 1919, became one of the world's first airlines. ... In 1924, Handley Page Transport merged with three other carriers and formed Imperial Airways, Britain's first national airline.

fact: 英国飞行家克劳德·格雷厄姆-怀特（Claude Grahame-White）于1910年10月29日赢得戈登·贝内特杯（Gordon Bennett Cup）。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Timeline: 1910
sources.quote: 29-Oct-10 Claude Grahame-White wins the Gordon Bennett Cup

fact: 朗特里与拉斯克（Rowntree and Lasker）对英国失业问题的研究发现，23.3%的失业案例以年老为主因。

sources.title: Abraham Epstein, Facing old age (Gutenberg eBook #77562)
sources.quote: Rowntree and Lasker, in a study of unemployment in Great Britain, found old age the primary causal factor in 23.3 per cent. of the cases studied.

fact: 英国贸易部对94个工业城镇工人住房的调查（1905年10月采集数据，1908年以议会文件Cd.3864公布）显示：伦敦两居室住宅周租平均6先令，外省同类型平均3先令3便士；伦敦3至6居室住宅周租平均约7先令6便士至13先令。该调查摘要明确结论：伦敦房租显著高于外省，差距接近两倍。

sources.title: Maurice Bellom, Le coût de la vie en Angleterre, Journal de la société statistique de Paris, tome 49 (1908), pp. 122-131（Numdam数字版，转述英国贸易部Cd.3864调查结果）
sources.quote: Ainsi on voit que les logements à 2 pièces se louent en moyenne : 6s0d à Londres 3S 3d en province et que les logements à 3, 4, 5 et 6 pièces se louent en moyenne respectivement : 78 6d 9S 0d 1 ls 0d 13S 0d à Londres ... Les loyers sont donc à Londres notablement plus élevés qu'en province ; la variation est de près du double.

fact: 英国贸易部汇编的1,944份工人家庭预算（数据取自1904年家庭收支调查与工会、合作社问卷）显示：受访家庭周收入平均36先令10便士，其中每周食品支出平均22先令6便士；周收入低于25先令的家庭（261户）平均周收入21先令4¼便士、食品支出14先令4便士。

sources.title: Maurice Bellom, Le coût de la vie en Angleterre, Journal de la société statistique de Paris, tome 49 (1908)（Numdam数字版，转述英国贸易部Cd.3864所据1904年家庭预算）
sources.quote: Les renseignements mis en œuvre ont été fournis par les budgets de familles que le Board of trade avait colligés en 1904 (voir Memorandum on the consumption and cost of food in workmen's families) et par les réponses à des formulaires ... on en conserva 1 944. ... fact: 战前金本位下伦敦外汇的基本边界由铸币平价与黄金输出入点决定：英镑对法郎铸币平价为25.2215法郎（常记25.22），计入运保费后黄金输出点约25.12½、输入点约25.32；对柏林铸币平价20.43马克；对纽约铸币平价4.866美元兑1英镑，黄金输出点4.83½、输入点4.89½。汇率跌至输出点以下时黄金从伦敦流出，涨至输入点以上时黄金流入，这些边界直接决定1909年前后伦敦货币市场的利率与信贷条件。

sources.title: F. Straker, The Money Market, Third Edition, Methuen & Co., London, January 1911（Project Gutenberg eBook #61605）
sources.quote: the pure gold in one sovereign is equal to the pure gold contained in 25·2215 francs; that is, that as regards intrinsic worth, one sovereign is equal to 25·2215 francs, and this exchange of 25·2215 (usually regarded as 25·22) is what is known as the “Mint Par” between England and France. ... This rate is called the “Export Specie Point,” or “Export Gold Point,” between England and France ... an exchange of 25·32, and is called the “Import Specie Point” from France to England. ... With New York the Mint Par is $4·866 to £1, or 49⁵/₁₆d. to $1; the Import Gold Point is $4·89½ to £1 ... and the Export Gold Point is $4·83½ to £1

fact: 1908年7月31日英国下议院审议《1908年养老金法案》的上议院修正案时，拟要求申请人年龄核验"尽可能以出生或受洗证明书为据，无此类证明时以人口普查记录或其他官方文件为据"；财政大臣劳合·乔治指出，接受该修正案将迫使申请人取得官方文件并承担2先令6便士至3先令6便士的费用（相当于一周养老金的一半以上），下议院最终不同意该修正案，改由规章处理核验方式。1909年养老金发放时的年龄与身份文件核验即依此后的规章执行。

sources.title: Hansard, House of Commons, 31 July 1908, vol. 193, cc. 1970-2000, Old-Age Pensions Bill — Lords Amendments considered（UK Parliament Historic Hansard）
sources.quote: Lords Amendment— In page 1, line 21, at end, to insert the words 'as verified wherever practicable by certificates of birth or baptism or in the absence of such certificates by census returns or other official documents, or where no such certificates or documents are attainable in such other manner as may seem sufficient to the pension authorities.' ... THE CHANCELLOR OF THE EXCHEQUER (Mr. LLOYD-GEORGE) moved, "That the House doth disagree with the Lords in the said Amendment." ... It was perfectly clear if they accepted the Amendment that the man over seventy years of age, when required, would have to prove it in the way it proposed, and they would thus impose upon the person applying a charge of half-a-crown or three shillings and sixpence ...
